description:
Found by s501t (s505) writing a guard row.  Pre-existing on main a33ce274.

Reproducer (perl prints `ok Tie::StdHash`):
  BEGIN { package BS; require Tie::Hash; our @ISA = ("Tie::StdHash"); } print "ok @BS::ISA\n";
PCL: `Unhandled sb-c::input-error-in-load ... read error during load: Package Tie::StdHash does not exist` -- the WHOLE program is lost (a raw backtrace).
The emission puts `(p-require "Tie::Hash")` and `(p-defclass BS::plc-bs (|Tie::StdHash|::plc-tie-stdhash) ())` inside ONE top-level form (the BEGIN block), and the CL reader reads the whole form before the require runs.  The same statements at top level (no BEGIN) work.  in-package / reader-time package rule: CLAUDE memory reference_in_package_is_read_time.
subject: `BEGIN { package P; require Tie::Hash; our @ISA = ("Tie::StdHash") }` is a READ ERROR at load ("Package Tie::StdHash does not exist"): the p-defclass naming the parent is in the same top-level form as the p-require that creates its package -- pre-existing on main
